blocks.explanation:
\(\csc^3 x\) ka koi seedha formula nahi. Lekin \(\csc^3 x = \csc x \cdot \csc^2 x\) likhein to \(\csc^2 x\) ka integral \(-\cot x\) humein aata hai.
Is liye \(\csc x\) first aur \(\csc^2 x\) second function.
Parts ke baad \(\csc x\cot^2 x\) aayega; identity \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\) se asal integral \(I\) wapas aa jayega.
Plan: Example 35 ki tarah \(I\) ki equation bana kar solve karein, aur \(\int \csc x\,dx = \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\) use karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(I = \int \csc^3 x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: parts: \(f = \csc x\), \(g = \csc^2 x\); phir \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\) aur \(I\) solve.

Parts lagayein
\[I = \int \csc x\cdot\csc^2 x\,dx\]
\[= \csc x(-\cot x) - \int (-\cot x)(-\csc x\cot x)\,dx\]
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc x\cot^2 x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\csc^2 x\) ka integral \(-\cot x\), \(\csc x\) ka derivative \(-\csc x\cot x\). Andar do minus ka product plus, aur formula ka minus bahar.
Dhyan dein: teen minus signs hain (formula, \(-\cot x\), \(-\csc x\cot x\)); ek ek kar ke ginein.

Identity lagayein
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc x(\csc^2 x - 1)\,dx\]
\[= -\csc x\cot x - \int \csc^3 x\,dx + \int \csc x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(1 + \cot^2 x = \csc^2 x\) se \(\cot^2 x = \csc^2 x - 1\). Ab \(\int \csc^3 x\,dx\) yani \(I\) wapas aa gaya.

\(I\) solve karein
\[I = -\csc x\cot x - I + \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\]
\[2I = -\csc x\cot x + \ln|\csc x - \cot x|\]
\[I = -\dfrac{1}{2}\csc x\cot x + \dfrac{1}{2}\ln|\csc x - \cot x| + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \csc x\,dx = \ln|\csc x - \cot x| + c\) standard result; \(-I\) ko left par la kar \(2I\) bana, phir 2 se divide.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(-\csc x\cot x) = 2\csc^3 x - \csc x\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\ln|\csc x - \cot x| = \csc x\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(2\csc^3 x - \csc x) + \tfrac{1}{2}\csc x = \csc^3 x\]
Kyun: \(-\csc x\cot x\) ka derivative \(\csc x\cot^2 x + \csc^3 x = 2\csc^3 x - \csc x\). Aadha kar ke \(\frac{1}{2}\csc x\) jama karne se \(\csc^3 x\) mila.
